headline: The reactor waits on one signature
motifs: amber conductors stopping at the gap

eval_history.fix: berm was a shapeless flat blob, the frost hatch read as rain, and the two halves read as one tower with a stripe
elliptical insulator sheds read as torn rubber, conductors were candy-striped, slot read as a collar on the upper half
value structure collapsed to mid-tones, sheds read as pancakes and the meltwater pools as lily pads
sampled the focal and found it peaked at 185/255, so the lightest light was a mid-grey; blur was eating the core
upper half too plain, gap shadow read as a hard box, fin tips lacked specular life

eval_final.notes: Above the 8.5 floor with no dimension below 7. Focal verified at 253/255 against a 0-255 global range, so the slot wins the contrast war outright. Six eval iterations plus one script crash (art_kit.chips mask index overflow, fixed, not counted).
